Extracts JSON-LD structured data from a page

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.json_ld.inspect
puts result.json_ld[0].schema_type.inspect
puts result.json_ld[0].name.inspect
```
